Our target: COC(=O)[C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O. This is methyl 2-oxobicyclo[2.2.1]... Actually it's a bicyclic system with two carbonyls: one methyl ester, one ketone. This resembles methyl 2-oxocamphorate? Camphorate has one ketone and one ester.

Camphor (C10H16O) is buyable. Could we convert camphor to the target in one step? Camphor has a ketone but no ester. Could we do a Baeyer-Villiger oxidation of camphor to give a lactone, then methanolysis to methyl ester? That's two steps.

Maybe we can use a simple oxidation of a secondary alcohol to ketone and then methylation? Too many steps.
